text:
Devon M: Heads up — code freeze in 90m. If you have anything that absolutely needs to land, call it out here now. Exceptions will be small patches only.
Sarah L: Got a doc-only changelog fix I want to push. safe to cut a docs-only PR? :eyes:
Devon M: docs-only is usually allowed, but please link the changelog entry and the PR description. we need the author and reviewer in the thread.
Sarah L: will do — PR up in 10. @Marco T can you review?
Marco T: yup, will take a look once CI passes. quick note: I'm blocked on a dep bump PR that affects build image. that one may need an exception if not green by cutoff.
Priya K: is there a simple template for exception requests? Trying to avoid long threads.
Devon M: use the release-exception template in the repo, but paste a 1-2 line justification here. include rollback plan. example: "bump libcimg to 2.4 to fix nightly flake; rollback = revert PR; risk = low; requires runtime rebuild"
Priya K: ok copying: "bump python-reqs to fix prod lint; rollback = revert; risk = low; needs CI rebuild"
release-bot: Reminder: Release cutoff scheduled at <https://calendar.company/rel/2026-03-17|2026-03-17 16:00 UTC>. Please file exceptions before cutoff. :bell:
Marco T: pinging @eng-infra for extra CI capacity — large image rebuild might exceed queued runners.
Devon M: noted. @eng-infra if you can prioritize one extra runner for 30m that'd help.
eng-infra (via release-bot): queued an extra runner for 45m window starting now.
Sarah L: PR description: "chore(docs): clarify changelog process

- move unreleased entries to 1.6.0
- ensure authorship lines"
Marco T: looks fine. CI flaky on windows env but linux green. merging after green windows.
Priya K: exception request submitted: https://git.company/repo/pull/4856 — please review, tiny pip change.
Devon M: thanks. marking for on-call reviewer. if no objections by cutoff we'll merge as exception.
Sarah L: merged docs PR. cc @Devon M :thumbsup:
Marco T: creating the dep-bump PR link: https://git.company/repo/pull/4862 — large image rebuild. tagging @eng-infra for ETA.
Devon M: final reminder — if you need a post-cutoff hotpatch, flag it here and include a rollback plan. otherwise we start the RC builds at cutoff and lock heads. :lock:
Priya K: understood. thanks all.
Devon M: thanks team — will post final freeze announcement 10m before cutoff.
